result.title: Adaptive Memory for Online Reinforcement Learning under Sparse Model Changes
result.summary: We study the discounted reinforcement learning (RL) problem in a setting where the underlying environment changes between deployments. Each deployment provides $H$ observations from a fixed MDP. The reward function and transition kernel are fixed within each deployment. Across deployments, at most an $ε>0$ fraction of the reward and transition kernel entries may change. In this setting, learning each model to deploy from scratch may discard useful observations from past deployments, whereas pooling all past observations can bias the estimates of entries that have already changed. We then propose an algorithm that for each state and action pair, selects how much history to reuse to estimate the reward and probabilities of the next state. We start with observations from the current deployment and add earlier deployment observations one at a time, the most recent first. After each addition, we check whether a single average reward agrees with the estimates from all histories considered until that point. We apply the same check to the distribution of next states. For each estimate, we leverage the last history that passes these aforementioned checks. The optimal control policy is then computed on top of the fitted MDP. We characterize the average gap between the optimal return and the return of the learner's policies over a finite number of deployments. We demonstrate that when $0< |S|ε\leq 2$, with $|S|$ being the cardinality of the state space, our algorithm needs only the observations from the most recent $O(1/ε)$ deployments, and achieves a long-run average gap of at most $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{ε/H})$.

AI.brief_summary: 在部署间模型仅稀疏变化（至多 ε 比例奖励与转移项改变）的折扣 RL 设定下，提出按状态-动作对自适应选择复用多少历史观测：由近及远逐个加入旧部署数据，用均值与下一状态分布的一致性检验确定可用历史长度，再在拟合 MDP 上求策略并给出长期平均差距界。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以一致性检验决定历史复用长度」这一思路可供核查是否能对应 latent 推理中的证据/状态缓存淘汰、分布漂移检测与更新窗口选择；但论文属表格型 RL 理论、不含视觉表示，迁移仅为推测。
